summarize_logs.description: Cluster errors, identify likely root causes, and return a compact debugging summary.

logs.description: Raw logs, traces, terminal output, or CI output to analyze.

context.description: Optional context such as service name, time window, recent change, or failing command.

summarize_repo.description: Summarize repository architecture, code flow, and relevant files/components.

files.description: Concatenated file excerpts with paths. Include only relevant source, config, and docs.

question.description: Optional focus question for architecture, flow, ownership, or relevant components.

analyze_screenshot.description: Extract actionable debugging insights from UI, error, terminal, dashboard, or devtools screenshots.

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded screenshot. PNG is preferred for UI, terminal, and browser screenshots.

mime_type.description: Image MIME type such as image/png or image/jpeg.

question.description: Optional diagnostic focus, for example visible error, layout issue, or dashboard anomaly.

summarize_diff.description: Summarize changes, risks, affected areas, and review focus from a large diff.

diff.description: Unified git diff, PR patch, or copied change set.

context.description: Optional context such as PR title, issue link, release risk, or review focus.
